# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 in Volume 1; around 19 by Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c14 P10](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Student / Teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v4 c11 P5](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive girl with blonde, curly hair, fair skin, and large, bright blue eyes. As her illness progresses, she becomes extremely thin and pale, with a feverishly intense flush on her cheeks and delicate, almost transparent hands.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v3 c25 P0](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0000), [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c14 P1](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0001)_

## Personality

Opal is lively, vain, and obsessed with boys, suitors, and romance. She is fond of teasing and delights in having multiple suitors. Even when faced with a terminal illness, she desperately tries to stay cheerful and maintain her optimism, though she privately suffers from a deep terror of dying.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v3 c26 P5](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0005), [v4 c11 P5](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0005), [v4 c14 P11](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0011)_

## Traits

- Vain  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- Flirtatious  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v3 c26 P5](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0005)</sub>

## Abilities

- Crocheting  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>

## Goals

- To have many suitors and enjoy a gay life before settling down to marry  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c26 P10](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0010)</sub>
- To survive her illness and live a normal life with a husband and children  <sub>[v4 c11 P5](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0005), [v4 c14 P17](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0017)</sub>

## History

Opal grows up in Brierley and attends the local school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. At school, she is known for her beauty and her habit of flirting with the boys, as well as her susceptibility to drama and tears. After finishing her early schooling, she attends Regent's Academy in Port Marlow to train as a teacher. Following a bout of congestion during the winter after her time at Regent's, her health begins to fail rapidly due to galloping consumption. Though she attempts to remain cheerful and insists she will return to teaching, she is forced to give up her school post at Pale Sands. In her final months, she admits her deep fear of death to Nell Harcourt and expresses her longing to live a normal life. She passes away quietly in her sleep during the late summer.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P5](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0005), [v4 c14 P10](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0010), [v4 c14 P11](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0011)_
